title: London's Bungalow Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: London's Bungalow is a 1.00 bedroom, 1.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: 486 FOREST STREETLondon’s Bungalow in Seaside, FloridaDiscover the charm of London’s Bungalow, a thoughtfully furnished one-bedroom guest cottage in Seaside, Florida, tucked along the quiet pathways of Scenic Highway 30A. Located behind the main home, Pinetucket , this private Seaside vacation rental is accessed down a sandy footpath at the rear of the property and offers a comfortable stay just steps from the beach, shopping, dining, and entertainment in the heart of Seaside.Perfect for couples or solo travelers looking for a cozy 30A beach getaway, this guest cottage combines a convenient location with the relaxed atmosphere that makes Seaside one of the most sought-after destinations on Florida’s Emerald Coast.Second Floor – Kitchenette, Dining Area & BathroomExterior stairs lead to the entrance of the cottage, where guests step into the main living area featuring a kitchenette with a mini refrigerator, microwave, coffee maker, and a small dining area for two. A flat-screen TV is mounted above the kitchenette, creating a comfortable space to relax after a day at the beach.This level includes the full bathroom with a barn door entry, double vanity, and a glass enclosed walk-in shower. Please note: guests must carry luggage up the exterior staircase to access the cottage.Third Floor – King Bedroom The upper level features the sleeping area with a king bed, two nightstands with lamps, a flat-screen TV, and a small closet. The bedroom offers a quiet and comfortable place to unwind after exploring Seaside, WaterColor, Grayton Beach, and the surrounding 30A communities. (Please note the bathroom is located on the second floor and is not ensuite.)Prime Seaside Location Near the BeachLondon’s Bungalow is tucked behind the main home, offering privacy while remaining close to everything Seaside has to offer. A rear gate opens to a sandy footpath leading toward Seaside’s tennis courts, fitness center, and recreational amenities.The beach is located just 352 yards away, making it an easy walk to Seaside’s white-sand beaches and emerald Gulf waters. Guests can also enjoy nearby access to the Seaside Amphitheater, boutique shopping, local restaurants, coffee shops, and biking paths throughout Scenic Highway 30A.Why Guests Love London’s BungalowPrivate one-bedroom guest cottage in Seaside, FloridaLocated along Scenic Highway 30A near shopping, dining, and the beachKing bedroom with flat-screen TVKitchenette with mini refrigerator, microwave, and coffee makerWasher & dryer includedEasy walk to the Seaside Amphitheater and beach accessConvenient access to WaterColor, Grayton Beach, and other 30A communities* 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2-night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURES392 square feetPrivate Seaside residential beach access at East Ruskin Pavilion; 352 yards or a 2-minute walk to the beach; the largest private residential beach on 30AAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis & 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply) and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a bottle of wine, and 2 rental bikes available to pick up at The Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided1 parking pass is issued. A golf cart is considered a car, and for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit.No pets allowed
